notes.title: BIG COOKING COMPANIONS UPDATE SALE!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="DC3FJVdc9p8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]ICYMI: Cooking Companions is OUT on [url="https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/"]Nintendo Switch[/url]/[url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262"]PS4/PS5[/url]/[url="https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010"]Xbox![/url] With the help of Serenity Forge, all owners of Cooking Companions on Steam will be receiving this gigantic update for free as our way of saying "thank you" for the incredible years of support. The game has also been fully translated into Spanish, Chinese (both traditional and simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese! In addition: [b]both [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263230/Cooking_Companions/"]Cooking Companions[/url][b] and the sequel, [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/"]Dread Weight[/url][b], are ON SALE![/b][/p][p][/p][p]在塔特拉山脈的森林深處，物資日益匱乏，洪水漸漸上升。你需要保持大家的士氣。你能夠討得關鍵人物的歡心嗎？還是終將淪為待宰羔羊呢？[/p][p][/p][p]タトラ山脈の奥深く山小屋に迷い込んだ若者たち。食料は底を尽き、洪水で水かさが増していく。みんなを励ませるかどうかは自分次第。機嫌を取る相手を間違えると、まな板の上で悲惨な運命が待っているかも？[/p][p][/p][p]타트라 산맥에 위치한 어느 깊은 숲속. 식량은 점점 바닥을 보이고, 홍수로 인해 불어난 물은 여러분을 위협해 오고 있습니다. 그 누구도 기운을 잃지 않도록 한 사람, 한 사람 신중하게 요리하세요. 자칫하다가는 여러분이 도마 위에 오르게 될지도 모르니까요.[/p][p][/p][p]在塔特拉山脉的森林深处，物资日益匮乏，洪水水位日渐上涨。你需要保持大家的士气。你能够讨得关键人物的欢心吗？还是终将沦为待宰羔羊呢？[/p][p][/p][p]En lo profundo de los bosques de los Montes Tatras, los suministros escasean y las aguas de las inundaciones aumentan. Depende de ti mantener el ánimo en alto. ¿Conseguirás convencer a la persona adecuada o acabarás en la guillotina?[/p][p][/p][p]Nas profundezas da floresta das Montanhas Tatra, os mantimentos diminuem e as águas da enchente sobem. Cabe a você manter o moral lá em cima. Você vai cair nas graças da pessoa certa? Ou vai acabar na tábua de corte?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/1659643e-3419-4faa-92f8-d569991d7c27/Cooking+Companions+PS5.png"][/img][/p][h3]What's New?[/h3][p]-15 new, fully animated, cutscenes [/p][p]-Some improvements to the gameplay (and rewards!) [/p][p]-Typos, glitches, grammatical errors are FIXED! [/p][p]-Fully translated into Spanish, Chinese (both traditional and simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese [/p][p]-A few secrets to discover![/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist and Preorder![/h3][p]If you want to support the game coming to consoles: please grab the game using the links below. [url="https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/"]Nintendo Switch[/url] [url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262"]PS4/PS5[/url] [url="https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010"]Xbox[/url] [url="https://store.serenityforge.com/products/cooking-companions-premium-edition"]Special physical edition for PS5[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/3a461b2e-fcdd-42a2-9b11-7d9e0071e850/Cooking+Companions+Console+Announcement.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This wouldn't have been possible without all of you: THANKS FOR PLAYING and ENJOY! [/p][p][/p][p]-Deer Dream Studios[/p]

notes.title: Cooking Companions HUGE Console Release Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=StjpXRmZL5I;full][/previewyoutube]
Cooking Companions is OUT on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]/[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262]PS4/PS5[/url]/[url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010]Xbox![/url] With the help of Serenity Forge, all owners of Cooking Companions Steam will be receiving this gigantic update for free as our way of saying "thank you" for the incredible years of support. The game has also been fully translated into Spanish, Chinese (both traditional and simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese!

[url=https://store.serenityforge.com/products/cooking-companions-premium-edition][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/1659643e-3419-4faa-92f8-d569991d7c27/Cooking+Companions+PS5.png[/img][/url]

[h3]What's New?[/h3]
-15 new, fully animated, cutscenes
-Some improvements to the gameplay (and rewards!)
-Typos, glitches, grammatical errors are FIXED!
-Fully translated into Spanish, Chinese (both traditional and simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese
-A few secrets to discover!

[h3]Wishlist and Preorder![/h3]

If you want to support the game coming to consoles: please wishlist (or preorder) the game using the links below.

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]
[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262]PS4/PS5[/url]
[url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010]Xbox[/url]
[url=https://store.serenityforge.com/products/cooking-companions-premium-edition]Special physical edition for PS5[/url]

[url=www.deerdreamstudios.com][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/3a461b2e-fcdd-42a2-9b11-7d9e0071e850/Cooking+Companions+Console+Announcement.png[/img][/url]

This wouldn't have been possible without all of you: THANKS FOR PLAYING and ENJOY!

-Deer Dream Studios

notes.title: Updated Demo for the Steam Spring event!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=n6rm3FUJJdw;full][/previewyoutube]
IT'S HERE! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]The Cooking Companions sequel, Dread Weight, has a new demo LIVE[/url] Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]wishlist the game on Steam:[/url] every one helps us out!

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/0c9a9dde-b708-4ca2-9071-6a220df9dac7/Nyaaati+Gisela+Cosplay+Dread+Weight.jpg?format=750w[/img]
[i]Cosplayer: Nyaaati[/i]
[h2]The Demo[/h2]
Trapped in a crumbling mansion, you need to scavenge for items to outsmart and outlive an ancient witch hunting you down. If you've played the original Dread Weight demo, get ready: the new version has MORE story, MORE horror and cool unlockables to discover!

[list]
[*]A sequel to Cooking Companions you can go into completely fresh: returning players get additional Chompettes, sidequests and story from the MC's perspective!
[/list]
[list]
[*]Japanese and Spanish translations!
[/list]
[list]
[*]Casey Mongillo (Evangelion) voices Clover, the talking rabbit!
[/list]
[list]
[*]New music by Cicada Sirens (Signalis), Jarren Christ (Spooky's Jumpscare Mansion) and Demidevi (They Speak from the Abyss)
[/list]
[list]
[*]New horror animations by David Romero!
[/list]
[list]
[*]New inventory system allows you to set traps for her...or discover alternative routes to escape threats.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Death is not the end: encounters with ghosts are rewarded in Dread Weight. Surviving them gives you additional story and background to the characters, while the game story continues to progress. No frustrating dead ends or 'Game Over' screens to deal with!
[/list]
[list]
[*]Listened to your feedback: no boss fights, skippable credits, more romance.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The Dread Weight Demo has four endings and four different encounters. 
[/list]

[h2]Full Translated into Spanish and Japanese![/h2]
Please enjoy the translated demo!

[h2]Want to talk to other fans about the demo or see the best fan made content?[/h2] 
Use #DreadWeight (or #CookingCompanions2 on TikTok) on social media: we'll be reposting the best content to all of our accounts! Have TikTok? Please search "Dread Weight", click the "..." in the upper right hand corner and then click "Share Feedback." Tell TikTok that Dread Weight is a videogame, not an eating disorder!

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/39d4fa8b-a071-440e-9a72-1b50cba7d5dc/Nyaaati+Gisela+Cosplay+Dread+Weight+2.jpg?format=750w[/img]

Enjoy!

[b]-Deer Dream Studios[/b]

notes.title: LAST CHANCE: Cooking Companions for -34% off!
notes.content:
Grab Cooking Companions for -34% off during the Steam Autumn sale, now available in Spanish, Japanese and Portuguese!

For updates: check out [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@deerdreamstudios]TikTok[/url],[url=https://www.deerdreamstudios.com/]the site[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/DeerDreamStudio]follow us on Twitter[/url] (and Threads!)

Missing some endings? Check them all out on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@DeerDreamStudios/videos]YouTube channel.[/url] Like and subscribe to help out!

Lastly: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]the sequel has a playable demo![/url] Wishlist it, try it out and let us know what you think.
[previewyoutube=TezNK-J1f7o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Spanish Translation/Traduccion en Español[/h2]

¡Finalmente está aquí! ¡Cooking Companions ya está disponible en español!

Enfréntate a tus miedos en este lindo juego de terror psicológico, basado en el folclore de Europa del Este.

Es corto y sencillo: puedes completar el juego en 3 horas o pasar muchas más buscando los secretos y logros ocultos.

Agréganos en las redes sociales o suscríbete a nuestro canal de YouTube para recibir actualizaciones de futuros juegos. ¡Disfrutar! -Deer Dream Studios

[previewyoutube=zakoHKU4Das;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Japanese Translation/日本語訳[/h2]
お待たせいたしました！クッキング・コンパニオンズが日本語で登場！

このカワイイサイコホラーノベルゲームは、食うか食われるかの世界。食べる相手の用意は周到？それとも食べられる側になってしまうのか？！

ゲームは３時間でサクッとも遊べるし、隠された秘密やタスクを沢山見つけてじっくりプレイも可能。

SNSに追加、またはユーチューブチャンネルに登録してゲームの最新情報をゲットしてくださいね！エンジョイ！
”ディア・ドリーム・ストゥディオズ”

[previewyoutube=WVmlCPsz4Po;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Portuguese Translation/A tradução Brasileira de Cooking Companions chegou! [/h2]
[previewyoutube=PEcgE2Cgrjo;full][/previewyoutube]
Nas profundezas da floresta das Montanhas Tatra, suprimentos decaem e as enchentes sobem. Cabe a você manter a autoestima e colocar suas habilidades de sobrevivência em prática. Será que você vai conquistar a pessoa certa? Ou vai acabar na tábua de corte?

Enjoy!

-Deer Dream Studios
